import csv
target='2018-07-04'
cool='c9fc3c98-8ad8-5bba-a072-0a5c02357f48'
heat='dcb57f97-6711-5249-9f6f-3a81a69fc8d6'
temp='c49bbc2f-096e-5e16-bead-066250790308'
dcool={}; dheat={}; dtemp={}
with open(VALUES_CSV) as f:
    for row in csv.DictReader(f):
        if not row['timestamp'].startswith(target):
            continue
        tid=row['timeseries_id']
        v=float(row['value'])
        ts=row['timestamp']
        if tid==cool: dcool[ts]=v
        elif tid==heat: dheat[ts]=v
        elif tid==temp: dtemp[ts]=v
print(len(dcool),len(dheat),len(dtemp))
common=set(dcool).intersection(dheat).intersection(dtemp)
print('common', len(common))
viol=False
for ts in sorted(common):
    h=dheat[ts]; c=dcool[ts]; t=dtemp[ts]
    if not (h<=t<=c):
        viol=True
        print('VIOL',ts,h,c,t)
print('violation',viol)
